page.overview:
Who is Monda?

Monda is a Star Shark and a former pet animal of the Foxy Pirates. He left the crew sometime during the Timeskip.

Monda is an orange shark with yellow stars on him in the upper side of his body. It wears a red mask-like hood with black stripes. In the manga his underbelly is dark orange.

It is devious and sneaky. It is also good friends with Capote, and assisted him together with Porche in the first race of the Davy Back Fight, the Donut Race.

It is a powerful swimmer by nature. It is able to "combine" with Capote by putting the Fish-Man's legs in its mouth to swim even faster. This is called the Two-fish Engine.
